text:
Ana: quick brainstorm: for PlayLab OSS launch post, should we include a lightweight benchmark table (hosted vs dedicated) or keep it narrative? aim is to get devs to try the repo.
Chris: table helps but keep it small 1 line: p50 latency & cost per 1k tokens. add an expandable full benchmark in the repo.
Bea: agree. add a 1-paragraph "how we measured" and link to the benchmark script in repo. transparency builds trust.
Ana: owners? Chris + Bea on blog draft, Rafael to wire the benchmark script into CI and output a small CSV.
NoticeBot: reminder: draft for newsletter due 2025-07-20 11:00AM PT.
Rafael: will add a tiny GH action to run the benchmark nightly and commit results to /bench/results.csv.
Chris: Also want a 1-min trimmed demo gif for the blog hero. Rafael can capture from demo run.
Bea: social card copy options: A) "Ship a streaming demo in 30m with PlayLab. Benchmarked for latency & cost." B) "Open-source starter for streaming LLMs. See benchmark results."
Ana: we'll A/B on social. aim for release 2025-07-21.
Rafael: posting the GH action snippet in the repo: ```yaml
name: benchmark
on: schedule
  - cron: '0 12 * * *'
steps:
  - run: python bench/run.py --output bench/results.csv
```
Ana: great. quick ask: include a small "who should use this" callout. keep it focused on devs and platform engineers.
Chris: draft headline: "PlayLab Starter Kit: Open-source starter for streaming LLMs (30m)"
Ana: good. final checklist: blog draft (Chris/Bea), GH action (Rafael), demo gif (Rafael), social AB (Ana). publish 7/21.
Bea: posting draft in google doc now.
Rafael: will verify CI artifacts and push demo gif by EOD.
Ana: thanks team, once blog live we can push to Twitter, Dev.to, and Hacker News. keep PRs small. :rocket:
